cases.query: network packet loss metadata quorum instability
cases.text: Network packet loss destabilizes KRaft metadata quorum. Read controller quorum, broker ISR and consumer lag before proposing changes.

cases.query: ZooKeeper session expired legacy broker coordination
cases.text: Legacy Kafka ZooKeeper session expiration affects broker coordination. Inspect authenticated legacy session evidence; do not attach this runbook to KRaft.

cases.query: HDFS no active NameNode HA failover
cases.text: When HDFS has no active NameNode during an HA failover, inspect active standby state, journal quorum and DataNode liveness. Never trigger failover from diagnosis.
Kudu tablet unavailable requires read-only tablet leader, replica and tserver evidence. Master connectivity alone does not prove tablet quorum.
NiFi backpressure and queue age indicate flow backlog. Inspect connection capacity and bulletins without dropping queues or restarting processors.

cases.query: Spark executor OutOfMemory lost stage failure
cases.text: Spark executor OutOfMemory and lost executors can delay stages and datasets. Inspect executor memory, GC and failed stages before recommending resource changes.
Hive metastore unavailable is distinct from HiveServer2 SELECT responsiveness. Inspect SASL metastore namespace reads and backing database separately.

cases.query: healthy baseline no failure false positive
cases.text: A healthy Kafka baseline with no failure must not be attributed to ZooKeeper, disk or network merely from related historical advice.
